verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developer.playcanvas.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a proper llms.txt summary, and PlayCanvas ships multiple additional llms.txt endpoints for sub-projects (React, Web Components, SuperSplat, splat-transform, PCUI, Editor), plus documented 'PlayCanvas Skills' giving AI coding agents specific workflows and an MCP server for agent-driven editing. This is a well-documented, agent-oriented docs surface an AI-native user could point an agent at directly. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that agents successfully consume these llms.txt files in practice.
